projects.name: NMDOT ESTIP Project Locations by Year - Project Locations 2025
projects.notes: NMDOT eSTIP project lines for federal fiscal year 2025 (layers 0 and 1 are FFY 2023 and 2024). STALE: the ArcGIS Online item was last updated in 2023 and there is no layer for FFY 2026 or later, so most of these are let or built by now. No description, phase or letting date; FFY_LIST is the programmed year. PRG_PRIOR / PRG_2018..PRG_2021 / PRG_FUTURE are programmed dollar amounts (0 in the sample). LEAD_AGY, DIST_MPO, RouteID + FromMeasure/ToMeasure also present.

projects_note: No current (FFY 2026+) NMDOT STIP geometry service was found in NMDOT's ArcGIS Online org. NMDOT's live eSTIP is a web application, not checked for an open GIS feed.
parcels_statewide_note: null: no free statewide New Mexico parcel layer with owner names was found (ArcGIS Online search returned only land-management/ownership-class layers).

parcels_counties.name: Bernalillo County Assessor Parcels (published by City of Albuquerque AGIS, berncoparcels_forIDO)
parcels_counties.restrictions: None seen on the layer; not checked beyond the service metadata.
parcels_counties.notes: TAXYR 2026 in the sample. CompleteOwnerAddress / CompleteSiteAddress are concatenated versions. No value field.

parcels_counties.name: Dona Ana County Assessed Parcels (DAC_Parcels)
parcels_counties.notes: County-published, edited 2026. CAREOFNAME, DEEDHOLDER, ACCOUNTNUMBER also present. No single total-value field: land and building values are separate.

parcels_counties.name: Sandoval_County_Parcels (Sandoval County Assessor GIS)
parcels_counties.notes: Owner name only: no mailing address, situs address or value. Account_No is the assessor account; Acrage is text such as '160.949 ac'.

parcels_counties_note: Santa Fe County's TaxParcels layer (https://sfcomaps.santafecountynm.gov/restsvc/rest/services/TaxParcelsDB/MapServer/0, 90,742 records, fields ownernme1/ownernme2/pstladdress/siteaddress) answered for metadata and count but every record query timed out (60-90 s, three attempts), so it is NOT verified and not listed.
summary: Projects: only an out-of-date NMDOT eSTIP line layer (FFY 2023-2025) verified, nothing current. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; Bernalillo, Dona Ana and Sandoval county layers with owner names verified (Santa Fe has owner fields but its server timed out on queries).
